root.name: Nimzowitsch Defense: El Columpio Defense
root.moves: 1. e4 Nc6 2. Nf3 Nf6 3. e5 Ng4

overview: Black attacks e5 with the knight on g4, inviting d4 d6 and then h3 Nh6. White gets a big centre and tempi, while Black relies on pinning and exchanging on e5 or d6. It is an offbeat line where Black gambles on surprise.

white_ideas.idea: Push d4 and h3 to chase the knight
Use the space with exd6 or Bb5 pins

black_ideas.idea: Exchange on e5 or d6 to ease the position

typical_structures.structure: White e5 and d4 centre against Black knights

character.notes: Black loses time chasing a pawn; play is double-edged.

soundness.notes: Black wastes tempi and is reputed worse.

structure.notes: e5 clamp and then open lines.

level.notes: Needs traps; dubious so not beginner.
